## Workload

During the review period, grader Tomas Brennan completed 584 reads. The work required 495 hours, equating to 1.2 reads per hour. This workload has been recorded for review and provides the basis for consideration of the grading activity during the period. The volume of reads and the time recorded have been considered together to provide a clear indication of output. No additional workload information was identified for consideration in this review.

## Quality

A sample of 42 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 64.3 per cent. This result has been noted for monitoring and should be considered alongside the workload information above. No further action is required this quarter on the information available. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
